title: Iran
subtitle: from Mashhad to Tabriz
standfirst: Photos from Iran in August 2015, on the overland route from Turkmenistan to Armenia: Mashhad, three days walking in Golestan, Tehran and Tabriz.

cover.alt: A woman in a patterned headscarf walking past blue Persian calligraphy painted on a pink wall in Tehran

stops.caption: Over the border from Ashgabat and down to Mashhad by bus; the driver poured me a glass of tea on the way. Mashhad grew up around the shrine of Imam Reza.

photos.alt: A glass of tea held up in front of a bus windscreen, the driver holding a tin of sugar cubes
Tiled arcades of the Imam Reza shrine in Mashhad, pilgrims crossing the marble courtyard
Round and long flatbreads hanging in a Mashhad bakery window, a baker behind

stops.caption: In Mashhad a hiking group from Golestan asked me to walk with them: three days from Aliabad-e Katul, through beech forest above the village of Mahian and over the ridge to the Semnan border, down to a waterfall.

photos.alt: A horse grazing on a rocky slope above forested valleys
Saffron chicken kebab pulled off a flat skewer into bread
A mud-and-timber house and an old blue pickup in Mahian
Sheep grazing above the village of Mahian at dusk
A dead tree on a dry upland slope, forested hills behind
A waterfall dropping down a limestone cliff into a pool, forest around it

stops.caption: Tehran, under the Alborz. The Grand Bazaar is sorted by trade; my host took me up to Meygun, a mountain village an hour north of the city.

photos.alt: A woman in a patterned headscarf walking past blue Persian calligraphy painted on a pink wall
Expressway traffic and apartment blocks with the Alborz mountains behind
A covered lane of the Tehran Grand Bazaar, tiled shop signs over a shoe shop
Villas and building frames in a valley among bare mountains at Meygun

stops.caption: Tabriz, the last city before the border, with its brick-vaulted bazaar. Then north to Jolfa and east along the Aras into Armenia.

photos.alt: A shop wall of framed woven carpet pictures of flowers and a mosque
A man in a white shirt walking past a parked bicycle and an arched doorway
A brick-vaulted lane of the Tabriz bazaar hung with coloured lanterns, a man carrying shopping
An empty road crossing a dry plain towards mountains
